<!-- Keep private project notebooks, credentials and restricted data out of
the patch. For small wording/link fixes, keep the description brief. -->

## What & why
What task or observation motivates this change? What should a researcher or
agent do differently after it?

## Evidence and scope
<!-- Link the primary source or a minimal shareable example. For a scientific
or workflow change, distinguish observations from hypotheses and state where
the proposed guidance applies. -->

## Validation
<!-- List the checks and their results. For behavioral changes, show before /
after behavior and any regressions. If claiming broader reuse, include a new
case beyond the example that motivated the change. -->

## Checklist
- [ ] Every new link/citation is **verified** (URL resolves; repo/DOI exists).
- [ ] Placed in the right file/skill (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`).
- [ ] Citation style is consistent (`Author(s). "Title." Venue Year;Vol(Issue):Pages. doi:…` or `arXiv:…`).
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` (under `## Unreleased`) if user-facing.
- [ ] No datasets, model weights, or copyrighted text added.
